[P2] Resolve the untested defensive branches

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is not satisfied here. The supplied test always uses the helper that raises `HELPER_FAILURE`; it never exercises a different error message or an unexpected successful return. Removing either defensive rejection leaves the test's assertions unchanged. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and decide whether these failure modes belong in the scenario, with meaningful coverage, or whether the fixed fixture permits a simpler approach.
